name: Onboarderr
description: Onboarderr is a customizable onboarding site for your Plex and (optional) Audiobookshelf servers. It includes user instructions, server highlights, and an admin dashboard.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Container Path: /app. Maps to your Appdata folder to save config, posters, and logs.

paths.name: Disk 1 (Storage Bar)
paths.description: Map a drive here (e.g. /mnt/disk1) to track it in the storage bars. Add more paths manually for more drives.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: The port used to access the web interface.
